description: [BETA] Bases Nationales des Points de Recharge pour en France (IRVE) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Point d'Accès National transport.data.gouv.fr. The IRVE National Data Base is composed of static and dynamic data related to charging points for electric vehicles in France. The National Access Point constitutes them from the consolidation of the resources (files) published on data.gouv.fr by each developer, installer or operator. The consolidation of static data is currently ensured by data.gouv.fr. Coverage: Point d'Accès National transport.data.gouv.fr. The portal shows the English title as "[BETA] National Bases of Charging Points for Electric Vehicles in France (IRVE)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Point d'Accès National transport.data.gouv.fr. Its keywords include irve, vehicules-electriques, borne, vehicule-electrique, geolocalisation, fichier-irve-de-bornes-de-recharge. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, YML, GITHUB. The listing shows 2026-07-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
